text:
Ellie (CSM): Quick flag for OpalWorks (mid-market, ~85 seats). Active usage dropped ~37% month-over-month and renewal is in 21 days. I want to try a short 'stitch-save': 10-day rapid ops + 48h infra trial + a temporary downgrade lane. Low-friction, reversible. Thoughts? :thread:

Sam (CS Ops): Health funnel shows drop at step 4 (integration setup). I'm exporting the task trace and will share heatmap: https://go.redwood/opal-heat :mag:

Rahul (AE): I can run an exec reset next Tue 11am PT. Need 2 bullets: expected token savings from enabling cache, and expected latency % improvement.

Maya (SE): Cluster config has prefix cache off and small batching. I can spin a 48h canary to enable prefix_cache and bump batching. If we see token spend down >20% and 95p latency down we can present numbers.

Maya (SE): ```
Canary steps:
- enable prefix_cache on pool-5
- set max_batch_tokens=4096 for chat routes
- monitor: tokens/session, 95p latency, error rate
- rollback: rb_cache_toggle.sh if anything odd
```

Ben (Product): If CS captures 3 sessions where reranker seems off, we'll repro and check model variant match. Also want a one-question survey after enablement: "Did this unblock your integration? (Y/N)"

Ellie (CSM): Proposed 10-day stitch-save plan:
- Day 0: Exec reset call + signoff for 48h canary (Rahul/Maya)
- Days 1-4: Two 30-min hands-on enablement clinics for integrators (Maya/Sam)
- Days 3-6: Collect 3 failing sessions/examples (Ellie owns)
- Day 8: Offer a 30-day downgrade lane with preserved data + optional 10% overage credit if they extend 6 months (commercial: Rahul)

Rahul (AE): I'll draft the downgrade lane language and acceptable usage baseline. Ellie, can you pull last 3 invoices + 30/60/90 usage?

Ellie (CSM): Pulling invoices now, uploading to shared doc. Objective: keep this reversible and not a permanent concession. :seedling:

notify-bot: Meeting created "OpalWorks exec reset" Tue 11:00 AM PT (invite sent)

Maya (SE): I'll post the 48h canary metrics back here (median/95p latency, tokens/session). If token spend drops >20% we have a solid commercial lever.

Sam (CS Ops): I'll prep the post-session survey and the scheduler links.

Ellie (CSM): If this succeeds I'll add a short template to the micro-saves playbook called `stitch-save` so others can reuse. Updates after exec call + 48h canary.
